title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2026 SEP)
summary: A September 2026 roundup of user-submitted improvement ideas for Business Central, grouped by area such as agents and Copilot, development, financial management, localization, inventory, manufacturing, purchasing and sales. Each idea is listed only by title and author, with no further discussion.
key_points: Financial management ideas include native IFRS 15 and IFRS 16 accounting, using actual bank conversion amounts in payment reconciliation, and several PEPPOL and e-invoice fixes.
Localization ideas cover Italian translation corrections, Dutch XAF 4.0 and RGS support, and a French credit note type for global allowances.
Development ideas include showing bitmaps on list pages via Media and Workload Identity Federation for AL HttpClient calls.
Inventory and sales ideas include consignment, bin-aware application for lot-tracked items, over-shipping sales orders and an editable Shipping Advice on sales quotes.
General ideas touch on security group profiles, analysis mode on tablets and mobile, and approval workflow restrictions.
